facts.fact: Lucia 遵弟弟的医生朋友开出的处方，到城北一小时外的海边散步治疗，却认为毫无疗效。
facts.quote: Even when I’d come an hour north of the city shore for a prescribed ocean walk

facts.fact: Lucia 拧开药剂的瓶盖弹进沙里，将药一口灌下，好让自己麻木。
facts.quote: I twisted the cap of the tincture, flicking the cap into the sand

facts.fact: 野兽化作与 Lucia 一模一样的影子在她身后现身，三个白色光点回望她。
facts.quote: a mimicry of my own shadow, then three white dots peering back at me.

facts.fact: 关键转折：Lucia 提议野兽当她的导师、帮她开往 Otherside 的门（她的 Peculiars 不许她再开门），以教他融入人类社会作交换；野兽答应成交。
facts.quote: “I suppose you have a bargain, then.”

facts.fact: Lucia 举瓶致意后把 flask 里剩下的酒全部倒进影子体内，野兽抱怨不喜欢这味道并请她别再如此。
facts.quote: “I don’t like that much. Please never repeat,” it complained.

facts.fact: Lucia 回家重整图书馆：用新地毯盖住受损地板，旧纸分类处理，书先随意上架。
facts.quote: A new rug covered the damaged floor, sparing my feet of splinters.

facts.fact: Lucia 致电 Archive 追问遗失的文件夹与工作簿，接线员答废弃物品每周随垃圾清运丢弃两次，她的数月实验记录恐已不保。
facts.quote: we throw abandoned items away twice per week when waste management comes around

facts.fact: 结尾转折：Lucia 决定趁野兽仍愿意帮忙，投其胃口所好把它引诱出来以兑现承诺。
facts.quote: As long as the beast was still willing, all I had to do was lure him out.
